dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Did you see the report about the new public transport plan?
dialogue.translation: Nanga defaay seen ci xam-xam ci mbirum bu beesuwaay ci planuwaay bi ci saare?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, I read it. Although the government says it will help, many people are against it.
dialogue.translation: Waaw, ma deggoo. Waaye ci xam-xam ci mbirum laa wax ko ci liggéey, yallañu beesuwaay tewul.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I think the main issue is the cost. It might increase taxes, and that could have a big effect on the economy.
dialogue.translation: Ma wax ko ci liggéey ak liggéey ci biir. Xamle ci liggéey ak liggéey ci biir, tewul laa wax ko ci liggéey ak liggéey ci biir.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Probably, but they say it will create more jobs. I'm not sure what they will decide.
dialogue.translation: Ndimmalal, waaye lañu wax ko ci liggéey ak liggéey ci biir. Xamle ci liggéey ak liggéey ci biir, tewul laa wax ko ci liggéey ak liggéey ci biir.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Yes, but if they cut other services, it will be a problem. The public might be more affected than they think.
dialogue.translation: Waaw, waaye ci liggéey ak liggéey ci biir, tewul laa wax ko ci liggéey ak liggéey ci biir.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Let's wait and see. Although I'm a bit worried, I hope they make a good choice.
dialogue.translation: Yallañu seen ci liggéey ak liggéey ci biir. Waaye ci liggéey ak liggéey ci biir, tewul laa wax ko ci liggéey ak liggéey ci biir.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Yes, we can only hope. I'll check the news again tomorrow.
dialogue.translation: Waaw, xamle ci liggéey ak liggéey ci biir. Ma deggoo seen ci xam-xam ci mbirum bu beesuwaay ci suba.

scenario: Explaining a problem to customer service
frequency_note: words ranked ~700–1500 by frequency of English

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Hello, I received my order yesterday, but the color is wrong.
dialogue.translation: Salaam, ma ñuul ndigëlam teeré, ndax suufa yi jàmm.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I'm sorry to hear that. Could you send me a photo of the item you received?
dialogue.translation: Njoxe naa la. Dama taxawal ma sa nataal gi ñuul naa la?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Sure, I'll send it right away. Also, I need to return the item and get a refund.
dialogue.translation: Jëkk, ma taxawal li ndax. Dama yàgg sa nataal gi ndax ma sàmm.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Of course. We will not charge you for the return. Please check your email for instructions.
dialogue.translation: Jëkk. Duma joxe ma yàgg. Xam sa saataal gi ndax saataal gi ci email gi.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Thank you. How long will I have to wait for the refund?
dialogue.translation: Jërejëf. Ñunga bëj ci sàmm?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Usually it takes 5–7 days. Please be careful with the return label we provide.
dialogue.translation: Jëkk, li ci 5–7 fan. Jàmm naa la ci nataal gi ñu taxawal.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Great, I'll be careful. Thank you for solving my problem.
dialogue.translation: Jëkk, ma jàmm. Jërejëf ci xam-xamam.

dialogue.text: I want to achieve a high position in my career, but I know it will require a lot of effort.
dialogue.translation: Dama bëgg ci yàgg saaj am ci mbirum yu digal, waaye maangi xam ne ma dëgg te ma ndaxte a lot ci diggu.

dialogue.speaker: B

dialogue.translation: Oof, saama meta am. Lan laa bëgg ci yàgg ci diggu?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I'd love to lead a team someday, but I think I need more experience first.
dialogue.translation: Dama bëgg ci jënd yu ñu wax ci bés bi, waaye maangi xam ne ma dëgg te ma ngi ndaxte a lot ci diggu.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Maybe you can find an opportunity to manage a small project at work.
dialogue.translation: Lii laa bëgg ci diggu, ndaxte ma ngi bëgg ci diggu ci mbirum yu digal.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I hope so. Success doesn't come overnight, so I'll continue studying and improving my skills.
dialogue.translation: Dama bëgg. Sëkk maangi waxul ci bés bi, ndaxte maangi ci diggu ci diggu ci diggu ci diggu.

dialogue.speaker: B

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I try to exercise in the morning, but I don't do it often.
dialogue.translation: Dama bëgg jëkkëlu ba suba, waaye duma am naa ndimmam.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That's okay. The important thing is to listen to your body and find a routine that works for you.
dialogue.translation: Dafa dox. Saama yoon, ndax dafa jëfandikoo bëj ak jënd naa ndimmam gi ñu ko def.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I know. I feel much better when I have more energy during the day.
dialogue.translation: Dama xam. Dama am naa boobu ndax dama am naa jëm ci suba.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, and sleep is a key part of that. Do you sleep at least seven hours?
dialogue.translation: Waaw, ndax fii dafa jëfandikoo sante. Dama fii ci ñett fukk ak juróom ñaar?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Usually, yes. But my main problem is stress, not sleep.
dialogue.translation: Dama fii naa ndimm, waaye ndax ndimmamam dafa jom.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Stress can affect your health a lot. Maybe you need a new habit to relax, like reading or walking.
dialogue.translation: Jom dafa waxal santeam. Ndax mbirum daa am ndimmamam jot naa, ndax dafa jënd naa ndimmam gi ci ñu ko def, ndax dafa jënd naa liggéey ak jëkkëlu.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That's a good idea, because I want to feel healthier overall.
dialogue.translation: Dafa dox ndax, ndax dama bëgg naa am sante.

dialogue.text: I think plastic waste is a serious problem, but people still use too much of it.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I find it interesting how many cultural differences there are between countries.
dialogue.translation: Mën naa def ngir ndaxteel ci yoonu ci yoonu ci mbir yi.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, even something like greeting can be a custom that changes the behavior of people.
dialogue.translation: Waaw, ndaxteel ci wax ci mbir bu ñu, salam yi mën nañu yàgg ndimbal yi.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: For example, in my culture, it's rude to eat with your hands, but in some places it's completely polite.
dialogue.translation: Ci ndimbalam, jëfandikkat naa lekk ci liir, waaye ci biir yi, jëfandik naa lekk.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I usually expect people to follow local customs, but I try to respect different ones.
dialogue.translation: Ndaxteel naa yàgg ci ñu jëkkërëjëf ndimbal yi, waaye ma laaj naa jëfandik ci ndimbal yi yu bees.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That's good. I think many customs are similar in essence, just expressed differently.
dialogue.translation: Saama naa. Ma laaj naa ndaxteel ci ndimbal yi, ndaxteel nañu ci mbir bu ñu.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: So, the key is to be open and learn about the differences between us.

scenario: Discussing a problem and offering solutions

vocabulary.note: Yëpp naa ak 'problem'.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: We have a big problem with the schedule for next week.
dialogue.translation: Dëgg a ko ci 'problem'.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I know it's hard, but maybe we can find a solution together.
dialogue.translation: Nungi ci 'difícil', te 'quizás' nu ko jëfandikoo ci 'solución' ndaxte ci ñu.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I'd like to offer my idea: we could move the meeting to Friday.
dialogue.translation: Nungi ci 'ofrecer' ndimmam: nu ko wax ci 'plan' nu ko wax ci 'Friday'.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That sounds easy to do, but will everyone agree on the new time?
dialogue.translation: Nungi ci 'fácil' ci jëfandikoo, te 'estar de acuerdo' ci ndimm ci 'new time'?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Let's ask them first, and then we can decide what to do.
dialogue.translation: Dëgg a ko ci 'entonces' nu ko wax ci 'decidir' ci ndimm ci jëfandikoo.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Good plan. Let's do that and solve this problem today.
dialogue.translation: Dëgg a ko ci 'plan'. Dëgg a ko ci 'resolver' ci 'problem' tey.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I can't decide which option to choose for our trip: the bus or the train.
dialogue.translation: Duma amul ndigal ci yónne ci benn ci benn ci liggéey yi: otobis bi te tren bi.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Well, the bus is cheaper than the train, but it's slower.
dialogue.translation: Waaw, otobis bi dafa jàmm ag tren bi, te dafa sàcc.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Yes, but the train costs more, and we need to arrive quickly.
dialogue.translation: Waaw, te tren bi dafa yàgg, te nu fii ci liggéey nga.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Also, the train is safer, especially at night.
dialogue.translation: Teg, tren bi dafa jàmm, ci tey ci boppam.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: But the train is more expensive, and we can bring more luggage on the bus.
dialogue.translation: Waaw, te tren bi dafa yàgg, te nu ñuul yàgg ci otobis bi.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That's true. So maybe we should take the bus and spend less money.
dialogue.translation: Dafa wara. Te nungi xam ne nu yónne otobis bi te nu gise yàgg ci ndimbal.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Okay, let's go with the bus. We can save money and still have fun.
dialogue.translation: Waaw, nu ngi yónne otobis bi. Nu gise ndimbal te nu jàmm ci liggéey.
